reloadRequired.message: Please reload all Gather.town tabs for the extension to work properly. Press Ctrl+R (or Cmd+R on Mac) on each Gather.town tab.

step1Desc.message: Open each Gather.town tab and press Ctrl+R (Cmd+R on Mac) to reload.

step2Desc.message: Click the extension icon to customize which notifications you want to receive.

step3Desc.message: Work in other tabs - you'll receive desktop notifications, badge alerts (! icon), and sound notifications when something happens in Gather.town!

step4Desc.message: Click the extension icon and toggle concentration mode to temporarily disable notifications. The badge shows "C" when active.
